text_block_list.text:
After our outing, as Tokai Teio and I 
returned to the academy together—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, guess what! I feel like I kind of 
figured it out!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The answer to the assignment Prez gave me! 
The one about "What a Trainer means to 
you"!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm thinking of giving the Prez my 
answer now, but...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe♪ Thanks, Trainer!

Tokai Teio ran off looking quite proud of 
herself, but curious about the result, I 
decided to wait in front of the student 
council room.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer? ...Were you waiting for me?
choice_data_list: Because I was curious, you know.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...They said my answer failed.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
When I told them that my Trainer is 
someone who praises me a lot, but also 
tells me straight when something's not 
okay—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now then, about your answer from earlier—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If it is merely praise and scolding you 
seek, do you not think one could simply 
summon a household servant instead?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Urk! Now that you mention it, that's true, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Is that truly all your duty as a Trainer 
entails?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Why did you choose him, of all people, and 
decide to walk beside him?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Why did you choose her, of all people, and 
decide to walk beside her?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: T-That's...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"If you stumble over your words there, I 
can't give you a passing grade. You'd 
better go back and try again."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I mean... What was I supposed to say?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
How would you have answered if you were 
Trainer? Why did you choose me and not 
someone else?
choice_data_list: Because I love the way Teio runs.
Because I want to keep my promise.

text_block_list.text:
When I first saw Tokai Teio run, her 
powerful, carefree stride completely 
captivated me.

I honestly confessed that from that very 
moment, I had become completely captivated 
by Tokai Teio.
choice_data_list:
I want to see you shine even more as you 
run.

I want to see more of you running and 
shining out there.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Me too... I want you to watch me run 
forever, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I want to get so strong that I captivate 
you and everyone else, Trainer!

Seeing the strong light in her eyes, I was 
reminded once more that she is truly the 
only one I could train.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I see. You two might actually make a 
surprisingly good duo.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: P-Prez! Were you listening!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh. When you talk near the door, those 
inside can hear you, you know.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...I retract my previous statement. The 
assignment is over."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"An Umamusume and her Trainer share two 
bodies, but one mind. By respecting, 
trusting, and pushing each other, both can 
grow together."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you keep devoting yourself from 
here on out.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll do my best... together with 
you, Trainer!

The whole series of events served as great 
motivation, both for Tokai Teio and for 
myself.

When I made my "declaration of war" to 
Symboli Rudolf, we promised to give it our 
all together.

"At the amusement park we went to the 
other day, we made a promise about the 
future."

I honestly expressed that, both as a 
Trainer and as a person, I wanted to keep 
my promise to Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I... I want to keep my promise to Trainer 
too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I want her to see me surpass her, and have 
her praise me with a "Well done!"

Seeing the strong light in her eyes, I was 
reminded once more that she is truly the 
only one I could train.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I see. It seems I meddled where I 
wasn't needed.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: P-Prez! Were you listening!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh. When you talk near the door, those 
inside can hear you, you know.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Still... I suppose I really was too soft 
on Teio, wasn't I?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~? If it's the President, you can spoil 
me even more♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Don't get cocky. However, let's call it a 
day for today's assignment.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"An Umamusume and her Trainer share two 
bodies, but one mind. By respecting, 
trusting, and pushing each other, both can 
grow together."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you keep devoting yourself from 
here on out.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll do my best... together with 
you, Trainer!

The whole series of events served as great 
motivation, both for Tokai Teio and for 
myself.

When I told her that it was fine because 
it was Tokai Teio, she looked back at me 
in surprise.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: 'Because' it's me... ............I see.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Both the times I was happy after winning 
a race, and the painful times when I 
struggled with so many worries—"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The one who stayed by my side and listened 
was you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"It's *because* it was you, Trainer, who 
ran alongside me, that I am who I am 
today."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I don't want anyone else... My Trainer has 
to be you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Getting praised, getting scolded, and 
building the invincible Teio legend 
together!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of them—I won't accept 
anyone other than you as my Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Still far from a perfect score, 
but... it's a passing grade. I'll consider 
the assignment completed.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: P-Prez! Were you listening!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh. When you talk near the door, those 
inside can hear you, you know.

here on out.

motivation, both for Tokai Teio and for
